batting.name: STR Binny
batting.dismissal: c DA Miller b MG Johnson

batting.name: V Sehwag
batting.dismissal: c STR Binny b DS Kulkarni

batting.name: WP Saha
batting.dismissal: c DS Kulkarni b JP Faulkner

batting.name: GJ Maxwell
batting.dismissal: c SPD Smith b KW Richardson

balls.text: a wide yorker to end with, Smith misses it
Balaji staying wide outside off and Smith's going off this time, a full toss is lifted easily over extra cover
low and wide full toss dragged to deep midwicket
this is very wide outside off, he tries to turn it to the leg side, does that, but quite weakly
attacks another full one outside off but can only hit it along the ground to long off
full and wide to start the last over, driven to the sweeper
a widish slow bouncer to finish off, Faulker swings and misses
Johnson's hit Faulkner on the side of the helmet here, the bouncer's climbed onto the batsman, who was attempting a hook before recoiling as the missile headed for his head
moves outside off and tries to lift it over leg, but misses, and it scoots behind square off the pad
beaten by a slower one now as he swings in the air, but they earn another bye as it bounces before the keeper, who does not collect it again
mid off is up, this is pitched up, outside off, and Faulkner lifts it calmly over the fielder
misses a slower length ball angled across him, but they scamper a bye as keeper cannot collect cleanly
yet another full toss, outside off, to end the over, driven to the sweeper
a low full toss around off now, Smith shuffles a bit and whips it past short fine leg
full and wide once more, but fortunately for Balaji, it is driven straight to backward point
a wide yorker now, but in vain, third man is up and Smith squeezes it wide of the fielder
a full toss outside off is smashed back down the ground, and beats long on and long off
full and wide, hit through cover, Kartik and Miller converge on the ball, Miller picks it up, Kartik avoids dashing into him
a full delivery driven to mid off
gone now, backs away to leg, Awana hits the blockhole, and the stumps, as Samson misses
swings hard again but toe-ends it to extra cover this time
Awana pings it back of a length outside off and Samson goes to fifty with a flat-batted straight six
slower length ball on off, turned to deep midwicket
full into the pad, Smith shuffles a bit, and manages to run it fine
hits this full delivery straight to cover
goes across to a 139.8 kph full one and turns it square on the leg side

Miller's 'caught' one this time, but it has still not gone to hand, Binny mishits a slog, Miller runs forward at long on, it bursts through his wrists, but he has a second line of defence, the gap between his legs, it lodges between his thighs, he puts his hand underneath to prevent it from slipping out, but all credit to the legs there
tries to make room and upper cut, but is beaten by the bounce on this back of a length ball
chips a full one over cover
dropped, he jumps out and slams it into Kartik, and it rolls away into the off side, shout of 'catch it', that was struck very hard, and slipped through the bowler's fingers
goes back to force a length ball to long on
steps out now, is not to the pitch, but goes through with a mighty loft, and clears wide long off
swept hard off middle, deep square leg will get to it with a run to his right
leaves the crease, pushes it through extra cover
comes out, swings, manages a thick inside edge through midwicket
comes down the track, but Patel's quick and flat delivery is hard to get underneath, and he has to nudge it to leg
goes deep in the crease to punch to midwicket
goes across to off, this is fuller, and he knocks it back again
flat, quick, on a length, pushed back
drives a full one to long off
gone now, goes down for another slog sweep, misses, and Patel hits middle with a full delivery angled in
another full toss, Watson goes after it, but this time it travels flat and on the bounce to deep midwicket, will take him to 50 off 28
a full toss angled in, Watson wallops it high over deep midwicket
cracks this overpitched ball for extra cover
follows him as he makes room outside leg, Samson lofts the length ball, couple of bounces to long off
slower length ball on off, knocked back down the track
full on off and middle, drilled down to long on
Watson tries a huge slog sweep to one bowled outside leg, outside edge flies to short third man's left, he messes up the stop
full and wide down leg
one more, this is overpitched on middle and leg, Watson clears front leg and smacks it high and straight
Watson uses his reach, reaches the pitch of this one outside off and swats it straight down the ground
full outside off now, Watson smears it over extra cover, work for the sweeper, he nearly overruns it, but manages to save the boundary
Samson picks the gap at deep midwicket, this is full and angled in, and he clears front leg to swing it away
slower outside off, flashed to backward point
overpitched straighter now, and Watson cracks it over the bowler
Watson lofts this pitched up ball over extra cover now, stretches forward and powers it away
slow, short and very wide, he wants to attack it but is done in by the lack of pace
very full and angled in from wide of the crease, driven to long on

almost a run out, a slower length ball is turned through midwicket, Samson wants the second, but Maxwell releases the ball quickly even as he falls to the ground, Samson dives back, direct hit could have meant trouble
quick, full and angled into off, defended carefully
Watson is determined to go after everything, he carts this full delivery to Miller who makes ground to his right at long on but drops it, and it runs behind him into the boundary
goes hard again, but now he finds the bowler
smacks a pull to midwicket now
Watson tries to mow his big slog sweep, manages only an inside edge that somehow eludes his stumps
Samson continues to hit cleanly, this is overpitched on the stumps, and he's gone dead straight over the bowler, and over the rope
drags the length back just a bit, Watson punches it from the crease to extra cover
overpitched outside off now, and Watson has slammed it straight to extra cover
looks to step out, Kartik shortens it, and Watson defends it square on off
has a go at this full delivery but mishits it through midwicket, will pick up two
shortish, punched off the back foot to long off
pitched up and angled into middle and leg, defended
a touch fuller and square driven to backward point
again he goes back, has some width this time, and cuts hard to the third man rope with the man up in the ring
goes back to punch it to the bowler
appeal for leg-before as he pushes forward, but this was doing too much with the angle
moves forward and drives a full one to long off
goes on the pads again, is nudged square on the leg side
this one will go, he tosses it up just outside off this time, Samson makes some room outside leg, and lofts, very cleanly once more, over extra cover
flighted once more, and does not turn, nudged to midwicket
full on leg again, Samson clips it straight to midwicket
flighted full and angled into the pad, turned to deep midwicket
Kartik strikes first ball, umpire Erasmus thinks awhile before raising his finger, Nayar struck in front missing a sweep to one that does not turn, but that has pitched just outside leg
goes across, Johnson pitches it up on off, and Nayar keeps strike, easing it to long on
beaten again, 138.4 kph back of a length and moving away outside off, Nayar follows it in vain
makes good use of the free hit, goes back in the crease and slogs hard over midwicket
hammered down the ground, umpire Bowden stretches his right hand to signal no-ball and at the same time, also gets out of the way as Nayer cracks this pitched up ball straight back
holds its line and bounces outside off, Nayar tries to run it to third man but is beaten
Nayar mishits another slog, but will get two more as it is wide of deep midwicket
flicks a full delivery in the air off the pads, mid on runs it down to his right
Nayar cannot find the timing Samson has, he tries to pull this too hard, but mishits it, couple of bounces to mid on
a slower one into the pads now, it pops up in the air as he nudges it, but falls in the gap at square leg
some hitting from Samson, this is not short at all, but he's picked it up so cleanly, it flies to the deep midwicket rope
calmly moves forward and pushes a good length ball to extra cover
angled across him now, and he flashes it past point's dive, third man runs across
Nayar tries to deposit Awana over deep midwicket, but he gets too much underneath this length ball and it sails high before plonking down well inside the rope
tries to pull this short of a length ball but misses as it carries down leg
hello, this has been picked up from just back of a length and dispatched with disdain over the deep midwicket boundary
jumps out of the crease now, bowler shortens the length, and Samson knocks it back
comes in with the angle and is pushed down the track
shot, he's leaned into this drive, timed it on the up, and placed it past short extra cover's dive
beats him with a similar delivery outside off
defends a good length ball on off

Rahane's gone, there was no single here, he had rushed too far up the pitch, Nayar whipped this to Bailey's left at mid on, took a couple of steps out and stopped, the captain is quick to the ball and scores a direct hit, Rahane had already given up trying to regain his ground, he had no chance
mistimes a forcing stroke in front of square on the leg side
Nayar tees off now, picks this from a length and sends it soaring over the long on boundary
Nayar gets one away finally, shuffles across and swings hard through square leg, it is cut off by the deep fielder running from fine leg
waits on this length ball now, it holds its line outside off, and he guides it to third man
tries to force this good length ball from just outside off, but turns it straight to mid on
moves to off stump and pushes another tight delivery to covers
143.7 kph from back of a length, Nayar is walking across again, and has little room to do anything but guide it to point, not getting the run
moves across to off stump, pushes forward and defends this length delivery to covers
now he leans into a length ball going across him, hasn't timed it that well, and it slows down as it approaches the deep extra cover boundary, and is pulled back
tries a short ball, and even as it climbs onto Rahane, he swivels to pull it in the air to the deep backward square leg boundary
starts with a good length ball on middle and leg, Rahane carefully nudges it square
flatter and quicker one knocked down the ground for a single to long off
tosses it up much wider now, Rahane steps out, stretches a bit, and lifts it flat over extra cover
flights it just outside off, Rahane comes forward, it comes in a tad, and runs off an inside edge to leg
goes back now to punch this length ball in front of square on the leg side
tossed up a bit around middle, he plays for some turn, there isn't any, and a leading edge rolls to the off side
gentle length ball on the pad, nudged away
Miller ends it with plenty to spare, he goes to 51 off 19 as he gets low and slices it over cover again
wide low full toss, Miller places it in the air through the covers, and comes back for two more
slower length ball, Miller waits and pulls it wide of deep midwicket for a couple
in another universe, Pujara keeps on heaving and inside edging, and also keeps getting the hitters on strike
Miller's ended the game this over, this is full and wide, Miller slices it hard and flat, and it falls onto the deep point rope
third one of the over, Kulkarni tries a slower one, Miller takes it from just outside off, and swats it in front of square leg
Miller with another maximum, one more full toss from Kulkarni, Miller crashes it over extra cover
full and wide, Miller gets some bat on it, they go for the second as long off rushes forward, throw is at the keeper's end but Miller is alright
low full toss, around off, Miller steps forward and launches it over long on
Pujara tries to scoop this from way outside off stump, but he edges it into his body instead, scampers a single
full and wide, Miller reaches out and lifts it over covers, sweeper reaches it on the bounce and parries it in
Pujara cranks up and has a slog, but he can only mishit it tamely through midwicket
slower one picked from outside off and slogged on the bounce to deep midwicket
this is too wide outside off now
very low and wide full toss, slips under Miller's bat swing
flays a back of a length ball high over extra cover, hasn't timed it, and sweeper keeps it inside with a dive
out of nowhere, Pujara's connected with a scoop, he goes outside off, bends the knee and turns this length ball to the fine leg rope
Pujara steps out and heaves, manages a single to long on, what a struggle it has been
comes out, but cannot get under the ball too well, drives it to long off
flat wrong 'un, shortish too, Miller goes back and flat-bats it into the sightscreen
had walked outside off trying to go leg side, but this was bowled slow and full, and he dabs it to third man
steps out and clips a full delivery to long on
Pujara gives this full delivery everything, but it just rolls across the outfield to long on
skidding across him from a length and he cannot do anything with it
full and wide, smeared through extra cover, Bhatia throws himself to his left at sweeper cover and saves the boundary
tries to launch this length ball over midwicket, inside edges onto pad
length on the pads, turned in front of square leg for two
cuts across the left-hander from back of a length, is pushed back
shout for lbw as he misses trying to turn a low full toss to leg, probably sliding down
Pujara goes straight and aerial now, on the bounce to long on who's run across
Maxwell departs finally, he mishits this full delivery, it goes straight and high, stays airborne for an age, but Smith at long on judges it neatly
tries to square drive a full and widish one but is beaten
moves across and whips this full one wide of fine leg, but is getting only one
Pujara swings at a full delivery, and a thick inside edge runs fine down the leg side
low full toss, he drives with an open face to the sweeper
length ball worked to deep midwicket
loopy full delivery hit wide of long on for two more
what a show, slower length ball down the pad, Maxwell bends his knee and smacks it in front of square
full, slow and on the stumps, Maxwell is backing away to leg, and has carted it high over long off
another one swung over the bowler, Rahane will cut it off easily this time
Pujara manages to force one straight down the ground as he charges out, Rahane comes racing from long on, dives across and stops it a few inches from the rope
terrific, a full toss, Maxwell opens the face even more and drives through the covers for four more, he is toying with the field
shot, there is no width here, full and on middle stump, but Maxwell has opened the face and timed it in the gap past extra cover
then he sends in a low full toss on the pad and Maxwell flicks it between deep square leg and deep midwicket
well bowled, he angles it full and wide of the right-hander this time
sends it full down the leg side now
third man is up, this is short and wide, and Maxwell hops to cut it miles over the man
sharp stop from the keeper, this was a wide away swinging full toss and he got a thick edge to it, it was travelling but Samson reacted in time
a loopy slow and low full toss, Maxwell turns it through midwicket
Bhatia angles it in and sends it down the leg side
third reverse in the over, and third boundary, this time he goes way in front of square, dragging the full delivery over the infield, no chance for the sweeper
waits and places this full delivery wide of long off for a couple
now he tries to slog to leg, and Bhatia's slower one keeps very low to beat him, that was very close to leg stump too
Maxwell brings up 50 with another reverse sweep that clears point very comfortably
he sets himself up for the reverse sweep even as Bhatia is about to release the ball, and connects the low full toss to beat short third man
full just outside off now, Maxwell looks to drill it over extra cover, but only hits it along the ground to long off, is cross with himself
mishits a slog down to long on
almost bowled him, 91.9 kph full delivery pushed through, Maxwell plays it rather uncertainly, and only an inside edge saves him
Maxwell misses another one, he steps out looking to go over square leg but is hit on the pad
full and quicker on the pad, he tries to whip it square but misses
Pujara charges out, but only manages a thick inside edge to square leg
full one hit down to long on
89.2 kph, he will give you no pace at all, Bhatia, Maxwell tries to power it over the leg side, it falls well short of deep midwicket running forward
full and slow again, hit back to the bowler
steps out, Bhatia angles it in full, Pujara misses, and they scamper a leg bye
cut away for a single
106.8 kph to begin from Bhatia, it does not come on for Pujara who forces it in the air down to long on
angled flat into the pad, Maxwell misses as he goes down on a knee
comes out again and swings hard, mishits to long on
comes down the track and flashes it straight back to the bowler
bowled slower outside off, Maxwell slogs, a thick inside edge runs behind square leg
charges out and forces it through extra cover
comes out a tossed up ball, takes it on the full and hits it to long on
Maxwell goes off side this time, this is short and leaving him on the angle, he takes a couple of steps out, and forehands it over backward point
dabs a length ball to point and goes for a quick single
that could have gone too, back of a length down the pad, and Maxwell disdainfully helps it in the air, but fine leg is in the way
slogs a length ball, hasn't got hold of it, but it clears midwicket
a full toss to start the over, Maxwell uses his wrists and swats it over deep square leg
comes out and slaps it straight to point, did not have width
slogs a very full one to deep midwicket, along the ground
he stands miles outside leg before the ball is bowled, somehow misses one bowled flat but slower, stayed a touch low too
shuffles across and is hit on the pad with a googly
he sets himself up for another mow over the leg side, but this hits the pad and rolls fine
first ball of legspin is flat and angled in, Maxwell's slogged it in front of square leg
follows him with a full one as Maxwell makes more room outside leg, but can only dig it out
now he goes over mid on, goes back and to the leg side, and swings it over the infield
picked cleanly over deep square leg, full into his pads, and Maxwell sends it soaring

sitter dropped, Tambe settles under this leading edge at mid on and it goes straight through his hands to smack him on the face, he indicates he lost it in the lights, Pujara was trying to forcefully whip it over square leg
a chance, Maxwell moves down the track and to the leg side, bowler follows him with a slower one, he pops it back in the air, but it is just out of Richardson's reach
lovely delivery, angled in just outside off, makes him play, and straightens and kicks past the edge
slower and fuller, he taps it to extra cover
tries another cut but is done in by the extra bounce
this is one shot Pujara plays with lots of aggression, width outside off, and he cuts hard behind point
short of a length, worked to mid on's rigth
tries to whack a length ball down the ground but it moves away and beats him
tries to turn this shortish ball square on the leg side, but misses and they take a single as it rolls towards point
turned wide of mid on
they're picking out the fielders, although this is a sharp, tumbling take by Kulkarni at deep backward square leg, he's swung a short of a length ball and Kulkarni has not had to move much
walks out and dabs a length ball past slip to third man
Pujara wristily turns this length ball from middle and leg to deep square
full into the pad and turned in front of square leg
moving away outside off, left alone
opens the face and runs a length ball to third man
Sehwag sees deep point, and Sehwag will take him on of course, he slices this widish back of a length ball straight to the man however
follows up with a bouncer, Sehwag ducks
good length and right on the stumps, defended carefully
flashes at a wide outswinger and misses it
this does not come in and goes past the outside edge as Pujara pushes forward to defend
this keeps coming in, but Sehwag still creates some space to glide it to third man
short once more, ending around off this time, Sehwag goes on his toes and keeps it down
short and coming in, but slipping down leg this time
tailing in again, worked off the pad to fine leg
moving in and rising from back of a length now, Sehwag tucks it to fine leg
swings in full first ball and is timed to mid on's left, Faulkner dives and parries it away
